title: Mixed Duo #046 · 여 커브드 바스트·하와이안훌라 / 남 클래식 머슬·피치 듀이
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the wide granite courtyard of Gyeongbokgung Palace with a standard-height palace gate, low stone steps and a waist-high stone balustrade, empty of visitors, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Hawaiian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large silver hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (an iron ship's anchor, a silver small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single rose-gold bracelet. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Ukrainian Petrykivka floral painting (a black ground with bright red, orange and gold folk-art flowers), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense folk-art florals filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Norwegian man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, pale smooth skin with a soft pink undertone, a shy sweet smile, vivid copper-orange hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large platinum hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a silver chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre, a gold miniature anvil, a lead hammer head, a silver cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a copper hammer head, a gold round bell, a bronze small flared temple bell, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal rings. Extremely long round nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense lattice fills filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
RIGHT Pose: both hands sweeping his hair back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto slingbacks, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
